newsitem.title: USA: Realty ReFund stake held by Ohio investor. [CORRECTED 00:25 GMT 27/12]
newsitem.headline: Realty ReFund stake held by Ohio investor. [CORRECTED 00:25 GMT 27/12]

text.p: Harold Krause, a Cleveland, Ohio investor, said Thursday he holds a 15.48 percent stake Realty ReFund Trust or 158,001 shares of beneficial interest. (Corrects from "common shares")
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Krause said he bought the stake for $608,304 or $3.85 per share and holds it for investment purposes.
Krause said he bought the stake in the last 60 days, but did not specify in the filing the exact date.
Realty, of Cleveland, Ohio, is an unincorporated association in the form of a business trust.
